candidates.value_provenance_note: 2026-08-27 (Wave I, cold-start red-team finding): this value is NOT an independently measured concentration in this repo's chain of custody. The arithmetic is exact: OAV 280 (the value the intake registry records for this anchor, 'Defined raw-pea hexanal baseline: 1260 ug/kg (OAV ~280)') x 4.5 ppb, where 4.5 ppb is THIS REPO'S OWN hexanal odour-detection threshold -- itself a compilation-level number that has never been read off a primary table (see the hexanal ODT anchor's harmonization_note in this file; published aqueous hexanal ODTs span 0.3-14 ug/L). 280 x 4.5 = 1260.0 to the digit. It is therefore possible that the source reports 1260 ug/kg directly and the OAV is the derived quantity -- but that has NOT been confirmed against the paper, and the exact divisibility by our own unsourced constant is precisely why the two readings cannot be told apart from inside the repo. Scored as a hold-out point it is a consistency check against our own threshold, not an external measurement, and it MOVES if that threshold is ever corrected.

candidates.value_provenance_note: 2026-08-27 (Wave R): the source reports one value per commercial lot, not a single number. The scored hold-out number is the geometric midpoint sqrt(2445.0 * 52454.0) = 11320 ppb (4 s.f.) of the inter-lot min/max -- a construction of ours. The honest uncertainty is the band itself (a factor of 21.45 end to end), so a prediction landing inside it is weak evidence. UNITS BASIS: ug/L OF THE REHYDRATED 10%-SOLIDS (w/w) SLURRY, read as ppb on the aqueous slurry (rho ~ 1 kg/L). It is NOT a per-gram-of-powder basis and NOT a headspace concentration. DI-WATER CALIBRATION CAVEAT: quantified by HS-SPME-GC-MS/MS external standard curves with response factors (R^2 > 0.95), and the curves were built by spiking the authentic standards into DI WATER, not into the protein matrix (thesis section 2.9: "SPME extracts were prepared as described earlier ... except that pea protein solutions were replaced with 5 mL DI water and were spiked with known compounds at five different levels"). Protein binding of the analyte is uncorrected, so every value here is a LOWER BOUND on total analyte in the slurry.
